morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入包的未派生分析，但不把该人名视为马来语普通词根。实际书写应首字母大写；-etta 不能分析为马来语后缀。所列 IPA 为一种英语读法，个人读法应以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 女性名字 Loretta，中文可音译为“洛蕾塔”等；属于专有名词，不是已核实的马来语普通词汇。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name used in English and Italian; a proper noun rather than an established Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian editorial, bukan takrif rasmi DBP: nama khas perempuan yang digunakan antaranya dalam bahasa Inggeris dan bahasa Itali.
senses.nuances: 输入键及 headword.word 保留原始小写形式；正文按人名规范写作 Loretta。pos 使用 noun 容纳专有名词。英语、意大利语使用情况及不同读音见 [Behind the Name：Loretta](https://www.behindthename.com/name/loretta)。以下是称谓与人名的常规组合，不是具有固定词义的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Loretta is recorded as a feminine name in English and Italian. Its precise formation is uncertain: proposed connections include Lauretta, Loreto, and affectionate forms of names beginning with Lor. The name reference also identifies actress Loretta Young as a notable bearer. None of these connections makes Loretta a Malay word with a translatable everyday meaning. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/loretta)
